about.missionContent1: Our mission is to support local Bitcoin communities through open-source education and networking. We collect, organize, and create the necessary resources (courses, books, posters, flyers, videos) for the Bitcoin industry to advance.
about.missionContent2: We centralize knowledge to better distribute it through a simple, multilingual GitHub repository and an E-learning platform. We assist local Bitcoin hubs in their development with the right tools for their talent to grow.
about.commitmentContent:
Our commitments towards the bitcoin community are the following: 
 • Remain open-source 
 • Provide high quality educational content 
 • Translate our content in as many languages as possible 
 • Support Bitcoin builders in their entrepreneurship journey
about.coreTeamContent: PlanB Network is a collective of hundreds of contributors, teachers, community leaders, designers, developers, and organizers. Many thanks to the numerous people who have made PlanB a reality and continue to do so each day. (Wall of contributors coming soon)
about.coreTeamRogzyRole: Meneja wa bidhaa na mwanzilishi mwenza
about.corporateContent: PlanB Network is the joined project of three entitites focus on Bitcoin developement. In an effort to scale the bitcoin educational layer, they decided to collaborate to form PlanB Network. To succeed in our goal to bring bitcoin education to the world, many other entites have decided to contribute and join forces. Many thanks to them
about.storyContent: The PlanB network is an initiative to support Bitcoin education worldwide. It's the crossover of various passionate Bitcoin companies focused on education, open-source software, peer-to-peer networks, and the sense of communities. Together, they've decided to build the PlanB network and offer the Bitcoin ecosystem the right tools to grow. Our 2023 release presentation is available here.
about.title: About the planB network
about.subtitle: Bitcoin strength is our community. let's gather into a global bitcoin network.
about.manifesto:
We believe in the decentralized future that Bitcoin offers.

Our mission is to introduce Bitcoin to a billion people by a decade's time. Our tools are education and information. 

We support local communities of Bitcoiners by providing open-source educational content and offering a network of Bitcoin mentors.

Our philosophy is inspired by the cypherpunk manifesto. Just as they championed privacy, we champion education. We believe that knowledge is the foundation of freedom and change.

We are Bitcoin-only. 

We advocate for individual responsibility and the independence offered by owning your own keys. 

We urge verification, not blind trust. 

We believe that by fixing the money, we fix the world.

We are decentralized and open-source, avoiding any single point of failure. 

We encourage the free dissemination of our content. 

We aspire to a world that operates from the bottom up, where the individual is at the center.

We simplify, we educate, we share. 

Join us in our mission to orange-pill the world.
about.description: Plan ₿ Network inasaidiya jamii kote ulimwenguni kujiandaa ili kutoa elimu bora. Jukwaa hili linatengeneza zana muhimu kuelekea lengo hilo, kupitia chuo kikuu cha mtandaoni, portal ya mafunzo, seti ya vifaa vya elimu ya Bitcoin na portal ya rasilimali.

Ikiwa unataka kusikiliza hotuba, kujadili Bitcoin mkinywa kinywaji, au kufanya mtihani ili kutathmini ujuzi wako, utapata tukio sahihi hapa kupitia Mpango ₿ Mtandao.

payment.additional_free_description: Tukio hili ni la bure, kwa hivyo hakuna malipo ya kuhifadhi kiti hiki. Hata hivyo, tafadhali hakikisha unahudhuria, kwani idadi ya viti ni ndogo.
payment.description_free_physical:
Tafadhali kagua maelezo ya ukumbi uliotolewa.
Baada ya uhifadhi kuthibitishwa, tutatoa tikiti ya uthibitishaji na msimbo wa QR ili kuwasilisha kwenye tukio.

Tafadhali pitia tarehe na wakati wa tukio uliotolewa.
Wakati ukifika, ingia kwenye jukwaa ili ufikie mkondo wa moja kwa moja kupitia ukurasa wa tukio.
payment.description_physical:
Tafadhali pitia maelezo ya mahali yaliyotolewa.
Mara tu uthibitisho wa hifadhi yako utakapopatikana, tutatoa tiketi ya kuwasilisha kwenye tukio. Tiketi hii pia itakupa ruhusa ya kuingia kwenye matangazo ya moja kwa moja na video ya kurudia, ikiwa inapatikana.

header.content: The PlanB platform aims to provide the best tools and educational content around the world to help people regain their sovereignty. From individuals to communities, we are here to help you along your Bitcoin journey.

tutorialSection.title: Making Bitcoin education simple is our objective.
tutorialSection.subtitle1: We help you master the technology with numerous in-depth tutorials!
tutorialSection.content1: Bitcoin is constantly evolving, with new actors, solutions, protocols, and technological breakthroughs coming and going. It is often hard to maintain a single, accurate database of good, updated tutorials. Here at PlanB, this is what we've achieved. From beginners to advanced users, you can navigate hundreds of tutorials to explore our industry based on your needs.

aboutUsSection.title: Who are we ?
aboutUsSection.subtitle: A little bit about us
aboutUsSection.content: The PlanB network is an initiative to support Bitcoin education worldwide. It's the crossover of various passionate Bitcoin companies focused on education, open-source software, peer-to-peer networks, and the sense of communities. Together, they've decided to build the PlanB network and offer the Bitcoin ecosystem the right tools to grow.
aboutUsSection.bitcoinFocusContent: Bitcoin revolution as a whole, from its base layer to various peer-to-peer communications around it
aboutUsSection.openSourceContent: We aim to promote the free flow of knowledge and to help build more open-source solutions
aboutUsSection.communityContent: We are first and foremost a community of enthusiasts helping each other on their Bitcoin journey
aboutUsSection.privacyContent: We consider privacy to be one of the most fundamental human rights and essential for progress

languageSection.title: No language barrier here.
languageSection.subtitle: Everything is translated to local languages
languageSection.content1: At PlanB, we believe Bitcoin is an international revolution that concerns everyone. To empower billions of people, we are designing this platform to be multilingual and accessible to all. The platform currently supports 7 languages, and more are being added every month. To achieve this, we use a mix of AI and the passion of Bitcoiners around the world.

patreonSection.title: Together let's make Bitcoin education better !
patreonSection.content: The PlanB Network is proud to team up with many bitcoin companies around the world in order to provide the best educational resources possible !

nodeNetwork.description1: Our financial system is crumbling, our food is being poisoned, our freedom is being taken away. We can't wait for a miracle, we have to create a safe place to live in. We must create our own PlanB !
nodeNetwork.pageSubtitle: Our strength is our community. Let's gather into a global bitcoin network.
nodeNetwork.descriptionExtend: Hatua yetu ya kwanza ni kualika jumuiya zilizo na nafasi halisi, ambazo tunazirejelea kama "nodi kamili" za mtandao wetu, kujiunga nasi. Katika siku zijazo, mtandao wetu unapoimarika, tutasambaza mwaliko huu kwa mipango zaidi duniani kote. Ikiwa unashiriki maadili yetu, tafadhali wasiliana na wawakilishi wetu ili wajiunge na mtandao wetu na kusaidia kujenga elimu bora zaidi ya Bitcoin iwezekanavyo.

exchange.description: Exchanges are one of the entry and exit doors between your traditional currency (euro, dollars) and the bitcoin world. Exchanges can be regulated and KYC (Know Your Customer) compliant, or peer-to-peer and anonymous. Each exchange will offer different features, fee structures, liquidity, and customer support. Each bitcoiner will use a different one based on their needs and convictions.
exchange.shortDescription: Bitcoin buying-selling solutions, KYC and non-KYC
exchange.title: Exchange

explorer.description: All these tutorials have been written by passionate and dedicated bitcoiners, who wish to spread bitcoin education throughout the world. Don't forget to like, review, and tip them sats!

mining.description: The mining industry is a complex topic full of rabbit holes within. Here, we will try to accompany you on your journey by using hardware and software. From modifying an S9 into a home heater to trying to win the lottery with a nerd miner.
mining.title: Mining

node.description: Nodes are like your personal servers. In Bitcoin, it's the software that allows you to run the network, collect transactions, verify the rules, and be truly sovereign. Within our ecosystem, there exist various nodes, from Bitcoin Core, to Lightning implementations, RGB, or other more advanced privacy solutions.
node.shortDescription: Solutions to operate a bitcoin node and join the network
node.title: Node

tutorials.pageDescription: Bitcoin is a wide industry, that becomes wider and wider everyday. To help you explore it, we’ve gathered a large number of tutorials that describe various solutions.
tutorials.pageSubtitle: Welcome into the infinite rabbit hole of Bitcoin!

privacy.description: Privacy is a fundamental right. While we aspire to a world where privacy is the default, it is not the reality we live in. We will try to explain to you the best practices, assist you with tutorials, and set you on a more sovereign path regarding your data.
privacy.shortDescription: Tools for backup and maintaining privacy
privacy.title: Privacy

wallet.description: A Bitcoin wallet is like your keychain. It allows you to spend and receive bitcoin. There are a lot of different types of wallets, all with different use cases, functions, costs, and user experiences. Each bitcoiner will use a different device based on their needs, level of exigence, and experience.
wallet.shortDescription: Security solutions and usage of your bitcoins
wallet.title: Wallet

business.description: Unataka kujumuisha Bitcoin katika biashara yako? Kategoria hii inakusanya mafunzo yote yaliyoundwa kwa wataalamu. Iwe ni kuanzisha mfumo wa pointi-ya-uzo ili kukubali malipo ya Bitcoin kwa urahisi au kuongeza na kusimamia bitcoins katika hazina ya kampuni yako, utapata habari muhimu za kiufundi na vitendo hapa.
business.shortDescription: Kukubali malipo ya Bitcoin na kuyasimamia katika hazina yako
business.title: Biashara

contribution.description: Unataka kuchangia kwenye jukwaa la wazi la Mtandao wa Plan ₿? Katika kategoria hii, utajifunza jinsi ya kuandika na kuchapisha mafunzo mapya, kukagua au kusahihisha maudhui, au kuongeza rasilimali mpya muhimu kwa jamii. Mafunzo haya yatakupa nafasi ya kushiriki katika elimu ya Bitcoin na kuongeza msingi wetu wa maarifa ya pamoja.
contribution.shortDescription: Changia kwenye jukwaa la wazi la Mtandao wa Plan ₿
contribution.title: Mchango

computer-security.description: Usalama wa kompyuta ni muhimu kwa kila Bitcoiner. Katika aina hii, utapata mafunzo kuhusu zana muhimu na mazoea ya jumla ili kulinda mazingira yako ya kidijitali. Mifumo ya uendeshaji, vivinjari salama, vidhibiti vya nenosiri, mifumo ya uthibitishaji, VPN, na masuluhisho ya mawasiliano yaliyosimbwa kwa njia fiche, nyenzo zote zilizowasilishwa hapa zinalenga kuimarisha usalama na faragha yako.
computer-security.shortDescription: Vifaa muhimu vya kulinda usalama na faragha yako ya kidijitali
computer-security.title: Usalama wa kompyuta

bCert.organizeDescription:
Wazo nzuri! Ikiwa jamii yako ni sehemu ya Mtandao wa Mpango ₿, unaweza kuandaa kikao cha ₿-CERT kwenye kituo chako.
Tafadhali soma <0>katiba</0> kuhakikisha unakidhi masharti ya lazima ya kuandaa mtihani. Ikiwa unastahili, unaweza kupanga na kuongeza tukio kwenye jukwaa.
bCert.bCertDescription: ₿-CERT ni mtihani wa mwisho wa Bitcoin uliobuniwa kutathmini ufahamu wako wa Bitcoin na mada zinazohusiana. Ikiwa utapata alama zaidi ya 80%, utapata cheti cha ₿-CERT ambacho kinaweza kuthibitisha ujuzi wako katika sekta ya Bitcoin, kufungua milango kwa nafasi mbalimbali za kazi katika uwanja huo.
